title: Payung Rahmah shines during Madani government's first year, says Fuziah | The Star
text:
Payung Rahmah shines during Madani government's first year, says Fuziah | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The Payung Rahmah initiative has emerged as a standout brand for the Domestic Trade and Cost of Living Ministry under the Madani government’s one-year leadership, says Deputy Minister Fuziah Salleh ( pic ).
She said the initiative now encompasses the Rahmah Package, Rahmah Baskets, Rahmah Sales and Menu Rahmah, with the most well-received being the Rahmah sales and menu.
